name: Firebomb · Death
primary:
A projectile flies where you look and explodes in a 2.5-block radius on hit. Effects:
• Damage 2.5 ❤ fire + 1.25 ❤ arcane (fire ×0.5 on wet)
• Heat: sets on fire for 12 s (wet targets just dry off), thaws; melts ice and burns roots
• Arcane instability: −0.25 ❤ every 2 s for 4.5 s
• Withering: −0.5 ❤ per second for 4 s
• Life drain: 0.5 ❤ damage, you heal 0.2 ❤
self_description:

• Damage 2.5 ❤ fire (fire ×0.5 on wet)
• Heat: sets on fire for 12 s (wet targets just dry off), thaws; melts ice and burns roots
• Arcane instability: −0.25 ❤ every 2 s for 4.5 s
• Withering: −0.5 ❤ per second for 3 s

• Damage 2.5 ❤ fire + 1.25 ❤ arcane (fire ×0.5 on wet)
• Heat: sets on fire for 12 s (wet targets just dry off), thaws; melts ice and burns roots
• Arcane instability: −0.25 ❤ every 2 s for 4.5 s
• Withering: −0.5 ❤ per second for 4 s
